purpose: Fit and calibrate the joint non-agentic uncertainty layer after B* persistence-first selection and before any 2026 forecast or agentic residual experiment.
epistemic_statement: 2016->2021 is used first as a transparent temporal hindcast and then as a pre-2026 calibration target under the fixed rule below. After calibration it is not described as an untouched holdout; 2026 remains the decisive untouched temporal test.

components: national innovation vector shared by all territories
current-region innovation vector shared within each of 12 regions
pooled local residual vector sampled independently by territory
hierarchy.decomposition: For each historical transition, national is the equal-territory mean innovation; region is the kappa=5 shrunk mean residual; local is the remaining residual.
hierarchy.zero_mean_enforcement: Each empirical component support is symmetrized by including the positive and negative observed vector/value.
hierarchy.cross_party_dependence: Preserved inside empirical multivariate component vectors; no independent per-party Gaussian approximation.
forbidden: post-result deletion of adverse validation diagnostics

selection_rule.vote: Select the lowest-scale candidate with componentwise mean coverage80 >= 0.75 and coverage95 >= 0.90; among qualifying candidates select lowest mean Energy Score, then lower scale. If none qualify, minimize total coverage deficit then Energy Score then scale.
selection_rule.turnout: Select the lowest-scale candidate with territory coverage80 >= 0.75 and coverage95 >= 0.90; among qualifying candidates select lowest mean CRPS, then lower scale. If none qualify, minimize total coverage deficit then CRPS then scale.

temporal_calibration.postselection_refit: After scale selection, rebuild symmetrized national, region-specific and pooled-local component libraries using both 2011->2016 and 2016->2021 transitions.

cross_state.reason: Two modern transitions do not identify a stable cross-state covariance robustly; no correlation is introduced merely because it improves one historical fit.

regional_ballot_bridge_for_F_minus_1.rule: The same sampled national and region innovation affects the 2021 regional-list baseline; the mean local residual sampled within that region supplies the residual bridge.
regional_ballot_bridge_for_F_minus_1.limitation: Only 2021 provides the current regional-list ballot; the bridge is structural and will be scored prospectively in 2026.

minor_party_legal_disaggregation.rule: OTHER is split back into the actual 2021 minor-party codes within each contest in proportion to their 2021 votes before applying the legal allocator.
minor_party_legal_disaggregation.zero_history_rule: A minor party with zero 2021 votes receives zero in F-1; later verified 2026 list entry requires a new B2/F0 snapshot.
minor_party_legal_disaggregation.reason: Treating OTHER as one legal list would manufacture seats and is forbidden.

pass_conditions: all fixed scale candidates are published
selected scales follow the frozen rule exactly
final component libraries contain no free territorial covariance
all probabilities and intervals are finite and normalized
